headline: Upgrade agent now picks per-case guides; codemod runs only on major crossings
summary: spawnNextUpgrade now selects a different-major, same-major or future-defaults guide plus a shared guide, copies only the needed version docs, and writes the codemod command only when the major changes. The agent prompt changes accordingly, including a new Future Defaults guide reference and a no-pending-defaults message.
focus: Bundled docs exist at every copied path (shared.md, per-case guides, version-N.md for each crossed major, codemods.md for 02-pages when installed major < 13), since a missing file makes cp throw
Same-major updates no longer run the codemod or write the codemod guide; confirm this is intended for security upgrades
Router choice (version < 14 uses 02-pages) matches where version-N.md files actually live
Prompt text for future policy when version unchanged and no defaults are pending
reason: Changes which files are copied, when the codemod command is generated, and the exact prompt handed to the agent, which is runtime logic.
risk_signals: codemod no longer runs for same-major updates
file copy paths depend on bundled docs
